Service Desk Technician - Network

Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

What you need to succeed

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

About the role and the team

You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

What you’ll be working on

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.

• Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.

Who we are looking for

You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screening Interview

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• References

• Final alignment meeting

Practical information

• Location: Copenhagen.

• The role is primarily office-based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and the expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• 
Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• 
Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• 
Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• 
Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• 
Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• 
Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• 
Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

The Perks

We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

How To Apply

If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

For more information or questions please contact us at haris@phanofi.com

At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

What you will be working on

• 
Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• 
Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• 
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• 
Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• 
Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• 
Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• 
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• 
Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• 
Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

Who you are

• 
You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• 
You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• 
You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• 
You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• 
You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• 
You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

What you bring

Must-have

• 
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 
4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• 
Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• 
Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• 
Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• 
CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• 
Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• 
Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• 
Excellent troubleshooting skills.

Nice-to-have

• 
Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• 
Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• 
Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company, however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as development of future transport- and energy systems.

Do you know what separates a backlog a team can build from and a backlog a team has to decode? We are looking for an experienced Product Owner who wants backlog craftsmanship to be the centre of the job — across three software teams building the platforms that run Eurowind's energy parks and energy trading.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join our IT Software department. Based at our head office in Hobro, Denmark, you will have your home base in our Automation & Masterdata team — and you will be the Product Owner who owns the backlog itself across all three of our software teams.

The backlog is yours, across three teams

IT Software runs three development teams — Trading & Monitoring, Automation & Masterdata, and Explore & Interact — with more than 15 engineers between them. We have deliberately split product ownership across three people with different centres of gravity rather than one generalist per team. One of your two Product Owner colleagues also holds the Scrum Master role and owns how we work: ceremonies, flow and continuous improvement. The other also holds project management and owns delivery towards the business: timelines, dependencies and stakeholder commitments. You will own the third piece — the backlog itself.

Your day-to-day home is the Automation & Masterdata team, where six developers and a team lead build the automation, data and masterdata foundation the rest of the business relies on. But because a backlog standard is only worth something if it is the same everywhere, your work will touch stories in all three teams.

Work reaches you from two directions. Larger projects and initiatives come in through our IT Portfolio Manager, who owns intake and demand at portfolio level, so a good share of what lands in the backlog arrives already framed and prioritised at a high level. The rest comes straight from the business, often as a half-formed idea from someone who knows their own domain far better than they know software. Turning both kinds into work a team can pick up is where you make the difference.

• Own the backlog as the single source of truth — capture, structure and maintain epics, stories and bugs so the teams always know what is next and why

• Refine feature requests into clear, testable items with acceptance criteria that hold up when development starts

• Set and maintain a shared standard for how work is written across the three teams, so a story reads the same whether it originates in Trading, Automation or Explore

• Make priority and scope calls together with your two Product Owner colleagues, the team leads and our solution architect

• Partner with our IT Portfolio Manager on larger projects and initiatives, and handle direct requests from the business for everything else

• Work with stakeholders across Operations, Trading, Commercial, BI and GIS to turn business needs into work the teams can act on

• Support release readiness — approve completed items and help stakeholders understand what is coming

• Keep Jira and Confluence trustworthy, so progress, dependencies and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask

• Help shape how we use AI in product work — we are currently building Claude skills that support user story intake and refinement, and this role has a real say in how far we take that

You will not be doing this in isolation. The three of you meet weekly with the team leads and our architect, and you will have a direct line to the developers whose week your backlog shapes.

Clear boundaries, real ownership

We lead with direction and mandate rather than detailed instruction. You will get the expectations and the boundaries agreed up front, and from there you decide how the work gets done. That only works if the roles around you are clear — which is why we have written down and agreed what the Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, Solution Architect and Team Lead each own, so you know where your decisions start and where they hand over.

• Real mandate over the backlog across three teams, and genuine influence on how the department works

• Two Product Owner colleagues, a Scrum Master, a solution architect and three team leads to spar with — this is not a role where you are the only one thinking about product

• A department leaning into AI in practice rather than in theory — we use it daily and are actively building Claude skills for user story intake and refinement, with the ambition of taking the mechanical part of backlog work off your plate so you can spend your time on the judgement calls

• A department in the middle of building its platforms, so what you shape now will still be visible in a few years

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Required competencies and skills

This is a senior position. Because the standard you set reaches every story in three teams, we are looking for someone who has done product ownership before and knows what a well-written backlog is worth on a busy week. We put weight on the following:

• Several years of experience as a Product Owner in a software environment, ideally across more than one team or product

• Demonstrated experience with backlog management, refinement and writing acceptance criteria that survive contact with development

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools; Confluence is an advantage

• Openness to working with AI as part of the job is a clear advantage, and hands-on experience using it for intake, refinement, documentation or stakeholder work is even better

• The ability to hold a shared standard across teams through clarity and collaboration rather than formal authority

• Comfortable moving between audiences — you can talk to a trader, an operations specialist and a developer on the same day and meet each of them where they are

• Structured in your approach, and at ease when priorities shift at short notice, which they will in a company growing in several directions at once

• Fluent in English in speech and writing; Danish is an advantage

• Knowledge of energy trading or the renewable energy sector is a plus, but something you can learn with us

A formal certification such as CSPO or SAFe Product Owner is a plus, but not a requirement — what matters most is what you have actually run.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record. A security clearance may become relevant later in the employment, but it is not required in order to apply.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Read more about Eurowind Energy A/S on our website (eurowindenergy.com) or LinkedIn.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV as soon as possible.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, at dot@ewe.dk.

Application deadline: Rolling – we invite candidates for interviews as applications come in.

Place of work: Hobro, Denmark

Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion

• 
Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• 
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• 
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

Data Platform & Infrastructure

• 
Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• 
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• 
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

Data Quality & Governance

• 
Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• 
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• 
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

Collaboration & Stakeholders

• 
Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• 
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• 
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

About You

• 
You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• 
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• 
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• 
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• 
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• 
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• 
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• 
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• 
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• 
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• 
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• 
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with data observability tooling.

• 
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• 
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• 
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• 
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Hartmann Packaging, a global leader in sustainable packaging solutions headquartered in Copenhagen, is currently seeking an experienced and results-oriented Commercial Finance Business Partner, Europe.

With a turnover of DKK 2 billion, operations across numerous European countries, and approximately 1,500 employees, Europe represents Hartmann’s largest and most strategically important region.

About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven and analytically strong finance professional to support our growth agenda by increasing financial transparency, optimizing pricing models, and driving revenue assurance. This role is a key part of Hartmann’s finance transformation, where we are building a proactive finance function that enables data-driven decision-making and supports strategic execution across the business.

As Commercial Finance Business Partner, Europe, you will play a central role in developing pricing strategies, improving profitability, managing contracts, and delivering actionable financial insights. You will work closely with senior leadership and commercial teams to strengthen the financial foundation for commercial excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Excellence & Pricing Strategy

• Develop and implement dynamic pricing models to enhance revenue and competitiveness

• Support the sales organization with financial insights to improve customer profitability

• Conduct in-depth market and competitor analysis to guide strategic pricing decisions

Revenue Assurance & Profitability Analysis

• Ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting

• Identify and mitigate risks related to revenue leakage and margin erosion

• Conduct detailed profitability analyses across products, customers, and markets

• Analyze cost structures and recommend initiatives to improve financial performance

Contract Management, Negotiation & Risk Mitigation

• Support contract negotiations with financial analysis and recommendations

• Advise on discount and bonus models for key accounts

• Oversee contract lifecycle management and ensure compliance

• Collaborate with Accounts Receivable to manage credit terms and collections

• Implement strong governance frameworks to safeguard revenue streams

Business Intelligence & Market Analysis

• Leverage tools such as PowerBI and Excel to analyze financial data and trends

• Provide timely, data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making

• Monitor market developments and business performance to identify risks and opportunities

Qualifications & Experience

• Master’s degree or Graduate Diploma in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field

• Proven experience as a Commercial Finance Business Partner or in a similar role supporting sales and revenue optimization

• Strong commercial acumen and ability to work cross-functionally with business units

• Solid understanding of ERP systems and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., PowerBI, Excel)

Skills & Competencies

• Deep understanding of pricing, profitability, and revenue optimization

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills

• Experience with financial risk assessment, contract management, and credit control

• Ability to interpret complex financial data and translate it into clear business actions

• Proactive mindset with the ability to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

We are looking for an extroverted, energetic, and proactive individual with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to make a tangible impact on business performance.

Why Join Hartmann?

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a forward-looking finance team and play a key role in shaping the commercial direction of Europe’s leading region in Hartmann. You will work closely with senior leaders, contribute to the transformation of our finance function, and have high visibility across the business.

Hartmann offers a competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and a workplace that values sustainability, innovation, and people development.

Contact & Application

For more information about the position, please contact Brian Ranvits from European Search Company at +45 2048 0548.

If this sounds like your next career move, please apply via link below.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Gentofte, Denmark.

Hartmann is the world’s leading manufacturer of moulded fibre egg packaging with approximately 2,800 employees divided into 3 regions Europe, North America & South America + APAC.

Hartmann sell egg and fruit packaging to producers, packing businesses and retail chains, all of which are increasingly turning to us to benefit from our expertise, both technically and in branding and selling their products. Our moulded fibre packaging is sold in markets all over the world with Europe, South America and North America as our key markets. We are a market leader in Europe and in South America and India, where our product portfolio also includes fruit packaging.  Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner for backup and recovery service
jobs.description:
Product Owner (Manager Role) for global backup and recovery service

Do you have hands-on experience owning or managing backup and disaster recovery services in an enterprise environment, including RPO, RTO and retention requirements?

For one of our clients, a large Danish company within the Life science & Pharma industry, we are seeking an experienced Product Owner for backup and recovery with leadership experience. You will become part of a dynamic and challenging environment characterized by high ambitions and a corresponding level of complexity. You will take part in shape the future of enterprise backup technology and safeguard the data that enables life-changing treatments to reach millions of patients.

Backup, and recovery

As Product Owner, you’ll lead and own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for the organization’s backup technology. You’ll take an active leading role and you’ll combine deep technical expertise in backup and cloud technologies with strong stakeholder management to ensure our service meets business continuity, compliance and operational objectives while driving continuous improvement and value delivery.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the IT Backup Service, aligned with business continuity, security and compliance goals

• Owning the product backlog by writing, prioritizing and refining user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (RTO, RPO, retention, encryption, etc.)

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement

• Defining and monitoring KPIs for the backup service to drive performance and reliability

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal backup policies, including data residency, retention, encryption and audit capability

• Managing incident response involvement for major backup/recovery incidents, leading post-incident reviews and implementing preventive measures

• Communicating roadmap, status, risks and outcomes to senior management and stakeholders in clear, executive-level language.

Your skills & qualifications

We’re looking for a Product Owner who can bridge technical depth with strategic vision, stakeholder engagement and leadership of the area.

You’ll bring with you:

• Expertise in people leadership

• Strong technical background in backup and recovery technologies, with solid understanding of RPO/RTO, retention schemes, backup architecture, snapshots, replication and restore workflows

• Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Technical Lead for infrastructure or platform services in an enterprise environment

• Demonstrated ability to translate technical detail into executive-level communication and vice versa, ensuring clarity across all organizational levels

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Experience working within regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) in enterprise IT environments is a plus.

Apply now

For additional information about the position, please contact:

• Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548

• Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638

If you see yourself in the position, please submit your application using the apply button below.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate is identified.

Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Are you able to ensure an efficient and structured workday while respecting all business priorities? If so, you now have a unique opportunity to bring your professionalism into play and act as a trusted Executive Assistant to the CEO and the rest of the executive team at Norican in Taastrup.

Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. Working within a dynamic team of executives, you will act as the primary point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders globally.

In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. This means your day-to-day work will offer significant professional variety through a wide range of administrative and coordination tasks. In this role, you will act as a gatekeeper, create clarity, and ensure smooth daily operations for the executive management team

Your most important task is to ensure that executive management's visions are effectively supported. You will do this by:

• Managing and prioritizing the CEO's calendar according to the annual business wheel, with a focus on allocating time for strategic meetings and urgent matters

• Acting as the primary liaison and local ambassador, ensuring seamless communication between the executive management, and all internal and external stakeholders

• Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• Handling global travel logistics for the executive team, including flights, hotels, transportation, visa applications, and travel expense reports

To succeed in the role

To succeed in this role, it is crucial that you can maintain oversight and act as a trusted partner to the executive management team. Your success will be measured by the CEO always being well-prepared, meetings being flawlessly organized, and your ability to intuitively anticipate needs before executive management asks. Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

You will work closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial, Market Access, and local affiliate teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of global initiatives.

You hold an advanced scientific degree such as MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent, and have at least 5 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in Medical Affairs.

• Experience working within endocrinology, rare diseases, or other specialized therapeutic areas.

• Solid understanding of Medical Affairs, drug development processes, and global pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and work effectively in a complex global matrix organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both internal and external stakeholders.

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Would you like an exciting career with a high degree of development and responsibilities?  Does it motivate you to be on the frontline of the renewable energy business? Are you motivated by designing, implementing, and operating secure, reliable network infrastructure in an international renewable energy business? Then you may be our new Senior Network Engineer in the Production IT team.

European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, and operate solar (PV) and wind energy projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. In addition, we explore new technologies, including battery energy storage, biogas, and carbon capture. As part of this, we are highly active in M&A activities across the entire value chain. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.

Your New Team

You will join our Production IT team, a newly established function responsible for building and operating scalable, secure, and standardized OT infrastructure capabilities across our global portfolio of renewable energy assets. Production IT acts as the bridge between OT systems at site level and centralized services.

Based in Copenhagen, this role will collaborate closely with colleagues across EPC Project Delivery, Operational Technology (OT), IT Security Operations, Asset Management & Operations, as well as a range of external partners and technology providers to support the successful delivery and operation of our renewable energy assets worldwide.

Your New Role

As our new Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for driving the design, security, and reliability of our network infrastructure across a growing portfolio of projects and operational sites. With a strong focus on network architecture, connectivity, standardization, and operational excellence, you will play a critical role in ensuring a robust and future-ready network environment.

You will work across the full infrastructure lifecycle, from defining requirements and reviewing designs to implementation, operational transition, troubleshooting, optimization, and ongoing enhancements, ensuring high performance and continuous improvement across the network landscape.

Areas of Responsibility

• 
Contribute to the design, standardization, and governance of network architectures across European Energy's renewable energy assets.

• 
Define and maintain network requirements, standards, templates, configurations, and technical documentation.

• 
Review network designs and technical proposals from projects, suppliers, and implementation partners.

• 
Design, configure, and support routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless connectivity, and secure remote access solutions.

• 
Implement and maintain network segmentation, firewall policies, access controls, and other network security measures.

• 
Support reliable site connectivity and communication between local infrastructure, central services, and external networks.

• 
Troubleshot complex network, connectivity, availability, and performance issues across distributed sites.

• 
Support the secure transition of network infrastructure from project delivery into stable operations, including technical validation and handover.

• 
Contribute to network monitoring, configuration management, lifecycle management, capacity planning, backup, recovery, and continuous improvement.

• 
Collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers, acting as a senior technical resource for network infrastructure across projects and operational assets.

Professional skills we expect from you

• 
Several years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise or industrial network infrastructure.

• 
Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

• 
Experience with resilient and highly available network design across distributed locations.

• 
Hands-on experience with network troubleshooting, traffic analysis, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis.

• 
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, documentation, and lifecycle management.

• 
Good understanding of network security principles and the practical implementation of cybersecurity controls.

• 
Experience reviewing technical designs, coordinating suppliers, and supporting implementation and operational handover.

• 
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in an international environment.

We are looking for a proactive and solution-oriented network professional with strong technical ownership and stakeholder management skills. You are structured, quality-focused, and comfortable working across multiple sites, projects, suppliers, and disciplines.

We Offer

• We offer an opportunity to take on a key role in building the Production IT function at European Energy.

• You will help establish how we design, operate, standardize, secure, and scale OT network infrastructure across our global portfolio, moving from project-based delivery towards a more structured and sustainable operating model.
